abstract: This paper provides a method to study quantile effects in discrete choice with social interactions. The method is based on a behavioral social interactions model from quantile preference in decision making and demonstrates peer effects on different quantiles of discrete outcomes. The peer effects parameters are estimated by a nested pseudoscore (NPS) approach, which is developed to tackle the computational burden pertaining to the social interactions model. Consistency and asymptotic normality are established for the proposed NPS estimator. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimator by Monte Carlo experiments and an application of peer effects among students on exercise decisions, using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种研究存在社会互动时离散选择中分位数效应的方法。该方法基于决策过程中分位数偏好的行为社会互动模型，揭示了同伴效应对离散结果不同分位数的影响。为应对社会互动模型带来的计算负担，我们开发了嵌套伪得分（NPS）方法对同伴效应参数进行估计，并建立了该NPS估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。通过蒙特卡洛实验以及基于美国青少年健康纵向研究数据集的学生运动决策中同伴效应的应用分析，我们验证了模型与估计量的有限样本表现。
title: Quantile Effects in Discrete Choice with Social Interactions
title_zh: 社会互动下离散选择的分位数效应

abstract: We study the aftermath of the 1968 Washington, D.C. civil disturbance to illuminate the mechanisms that drive urban redevelopment in the presence of low demand and racial tension. Using a within-block identification strategy, we show that destruction caused lots to remain vacant for the next thirty years and only recently converge in terms of structure value. The city acted to preclude for-profit land owners from leaving land vacant until demand conditions improved by purchasing nearly half of all properties in damaged neighborhoods. Despite this and other steps, the city had limited success in speeding up redevelopment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究1968年华盛顿特区民事骚乱的后续影响，以揭示在低需求与种族紧张背景下驱动城市再开发的机制。通过采用街区内识别策略，我们证明破坏导致地块在此后三十年间持续空置，直至近期才在建筑价值上趋于收敛。市政府通过收购受损街区近半数房产，阻止营利性土地所有者在地产需求改善前闲置土地。尽管采取了这一措施及其他举措，市政府在加速再开发方面成效有限。
title: Destruction, Policy, and the Evolving Consequences of Washington, DC’s 1968 Civil Disturbance
title_zh: 华盛顿特区1968年民乱：破坏、政策与不断演变的后果

abstract: We examine how the 1993 Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) impacts the gender composition at U.S. firms experiencing a negative demand shock. Combining changes in Chinese imports across industries between 2000 and 2003 and a sharp regression discontinuity to identify FMLA status, we find that an increase in import competition decreases the share of female employment, earnings, and promotions at FMLA relative to non-FMLA firms. This effect is driven by women in prime child-bearing ages and without college degrees and is pronounced at firms with all male managers. These results suggest that job-protected leave mandates may exacerbate gender inequalities in response to adverse shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1993年《家庭与医疗休假法案》（FMLA）如何影响遭受负面需求冲击的美国企业的性别构成。通过结合2000年至2003年间各行业中国进口变化，并利用断点回归方法识别FMLA适用状态，我们发现：相较于非FMLA企业，进口竞争加剧导致FMLA企业中女性就业比例、收入及晋升机会下降。这一效应主要由处于生育黄金年龄且未获得大学学位的女性群体驱动，并在管理层全为男性的企业中尤为显著。研究结果表明，带薪休假保障政策可能加剧企业在应对负面冲击时的性别不平等现象。
china_relevance_reason: 研究聚焦美国《家庭与医疗休假法》及美国企业，中国仅作为贸易冲击背景出现，非核心研究对象。
title: Family-Leave Mandates and Female Labor at U.S. Firms: Evidence from a Trade Shock
title_zh: 美国家庭休假强制令与企业女性劳动力：来自贸易冲击的证据

abstract: Using panel data on a 20% random sample of Canadian taxpayers, we study behavioral responses to the cancellation of a lifetime capital gains exemption that resulted in increased capital gains taxation for some individuals. We show that the exemption did not change the number of taxpayers reporting positive capital gains, and thus unlikely resulted in increased participation in capital markets. Furthermore, our results suggest that the cancellation increased the long-run capital gains realizations of tax filers with more unused exemption room but had a small, statistically insignificant impact on the capital gains realizations of those with little unused exemption room.
abstract_zh: 利用加拿大纳税人20%随机样本的面板数据，我们研究了终身资本利得豁免取消对行为的影响，该取消导致部分个人的资本利得税负增加。研究表明，豁免并未改变申报正资本利得的纳税人数量，因此不太可能促进资本市场参与度的提升。此外，我们的结果表明，豁免取消增加了未使用豁免额度较多的纳税人的长期资本利得实现，但对未使用豁免额度较少的纳税人的资本利得实现影响较小且统计上不显著。
title: Permanent and Transitory Responses to Capital Gains Taxes: Evidence from a Lifetime Exemption in Canada
title_zh: 资本利得税的永久性与暂时性反应：来自加拿大终身豁免的证据

abstract: This study extends the behavioral theory of the firm by reconceptualizing performance feedback as a multidimensional construct that captures performance relative to aspiration levels and performance relative to underlying potential. We define four feedback categories: legitimated success (performance above both aspiration levels and underlying potential), fragile success (performance above aspiration levels but below underlying potential), potential-confirming failure (performance below aspiration levels but above underlying potential), and structural failure (performance below both aspiration levels and underlying potential). Using panel data on 213 team-seasons from the Korea Baseball Organization (2001–2025), we examine how each feedback type influences risk-taking decisions in the form of top leadership changes and workforce reconfiguration. Our analyses show that structural failure is associated with a higher likelihood of replacing the top leader, whereas legitimated success corresponds to greater leadership stability. In addition, potential-confirming failure triggers significant workforce reconfiguration, whereas both types of success entail minimal workforce changes. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating underlying potential into performance feedback evaluation. By jointly considering performance relative to aspiration levels and underlying potential, this study advances a more precise account of how firms interpret performance outcomes and, consequently, when they pursue strategic change versus reinforce the status quo. KEYWORDS: Performance feedback behavioural theory of the firm underlying potential leadership change workforce reconfiguration JEL CLASSIFICATION: L22 D81 M12
abstract_zh: 本研究通过将绩效反馈重新概念化为一个多维构念（同时捕捉相对于期望水平的绩效和相对于潜在能力的绩效），拓展了企业行为理论。我们定义了四种反馈类型：合法化成功（绩效高于期望水平和潜在能力）、脆弱成功（绩效高于期望水平但低于潜在能力）、潜力确认型失败（绩效低于期望水平但高于潜在能力）以及结构性失败（绩效低于期望水平和潜在能力）。基于韩国棒球组织2001-2025年间213个团队赛季的面板数据，我们考察了每种反馈类型如何通过高层领导更替和劳动力重组的形式影响风险承担决策。分析表明，结构性失败与高层领导更替概率升高相关，而合法化成功则对应更高的领导稳定性。此外，潜力确认型失败会引发显著的劳动力重组，而两种成功类型均涉及最小程度的劳动力变动。这些发现凸显了将潜在能力纳入绩效反馈评估的重要性。通过联合考虑相对于期望水平和潜在能力的绩效，本研究更精确地阐释了企业如何解读绩效结果，进而决定何时追求战略变革或维持现状。关键词：绩效反馈 企业行为理论 潜在能力 领导更替 劳动力重组 JEL分类：L22 D81 M12
title: Revisiting performance feedback: aspiration levels, underlying potential, and risk-taking behavior
title_zh: 重新审视绩效反馈：期望水平、潜在能力与风险承担行为

abstract: In the context of the digital economy reshaping new forms of employment while social security coverage for flexibly employed workers remains inadequate,this study, set against the backdrop of digital economy reshaping employment and insufficient social security for flexibly employed workers, uses CFPS microdata to systematically analyze the impact and mechanisms of digital technology use on pension insurance participation. Empirically, digital technology use significantly promotes participation, a finding robust to various sensitivity tests. Mechanistically, it facilitates participation by raising income, job satisfaction, and trust in social security. Interestingly, the contribution base plays a negative moderating role. Heterogeneity reveals that the positive effect is stronger among middle-aged and older workers, agricultural hukou holders, less-educated, and married groups. Policy recommendations include a targeted digital expansion strategy, optimized contribution parameters accommodating flexible work, and a long-term promotion mechanism centered on improving job quality and institutional trust, so as to sustainably increase pension insurance participation. KEYWORDS: Digital technology flexible employment pension insurance enrolment JEL CLASSIFICATION: H55 O33
abstract_zh: 在数字经济重塑新型就业形态而灵活就业人员社会保障覆盖不足的背景下，本研究利用CFPS微观数据，系统分析了数字技术使用对养老保险参与的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，数字技术使用显著促进了养老保险参与，该结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析显示，数字技术通过提高收入水平、工作满意度及社会保障信任度来促进参保。值得注意的是，缴费基数在其中发挥负向调节作用。异质性分析表明，该正向效应在中老年群体、农业户籍、低学历及已婚群体中更为显著。政策建议包括：实施精准化数字推广策略、优化适应灵活就业的缴费参数设计，以及构建以提升工作质量与制度信任为核心的长期促进机制，从而持续提高养老保险参保率。关键词：数字技术；灵活就业；养老保险参保；JEL分类：H55；O33

abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。
title: The two clocks of systemic importance
title_zh: 系统重要性的两个时钟

abstract: Can broadband infrastructure serve as a catalyst for breaking intergenerational income links and promoting social mobility? This paper tries to answer this question by empirically examining the effects of broadband infrastructure on intergenerational income mobility in China. We exploit a quasi-natural experiment provided by the Broadband China Strategy (BCS) and employ a staggered difference-in-differences methodology to draw causal insights, revealing a 0.058 decrease in intergenerational income elasticity in pilot cities compared to non-pilot cities. The effect is particularly pronounced for males, cohorts born in the 1980 s, those whose fathers have rural hukou or lower levels of education, and residents in peri-urban areas surrounding major cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the increase in intergenerational income mobility is primarily due to reshaping employment opportunities in favour of disadvantaged groups. These findings hold important implications not only for China but also for other developing countries undergoing digitalization.
abstract_zh: 宽带基础设施能否成为打破代际收入关联、促进社会流动的催化剂？本文通过实证检验宽带基础设施对中国代际收入流动性的影响来回答这一问题。我们利用"宽带中国"战略提供的准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法进行因果推断，发现试点城市的代际收入弹性较非试点城市下降了0.058。这一效应在男性、20世纪80年代出生群体、父亲为农村户籍或低学历者、以及大城市周边近郊居民中尤为显著。机制分析表明，代际收入流动性的提升主要源于就业机会向弱势群体的重新配置。这些发现不仅对中国具有重要启示，对正处于数字化转型进程中的其他发展中国家同样具有借鉴意义。

abstract: The carbon emissions trading mechanism increases production costs for regulated firms, which undoubtedly encourages enterprises to participate in technology research and development (R&D). However, it is unclear whether the carbon price will lead to misallocation of firms’ innovation resources. When R&D labour and capital are misallocated, increased R&D spending does not necessarily translate into innovation gains. Therefore, focusing on China’s carbon emissions trading mechanism, we systematically examine whether the carbon price affects firms’ innovation resource allocation and further evaluate social welfare after correcting for such misallocation. The analysis indicates that the carbon price exerts an inverted U-shaped effect on both R&D capital and labour misallocation; beyond a certain threshold, the carbon price helps reduce R&D resource misallocation. Further analysis indicates that correcting these misallocations significantly enhances both the quantity and quality of innovation output. These findings expand the research on carbon price mechanisms, highlight the importance of innovation resource allocation efficiency in climate governance, and provide evidence for designing carbon price policies that balance emission reduction targets with innovation efficiency. KEYWORDS: Carbon price innovation resource misallocation R&D capital misallocation R&D labour misallocation welfare analysis JEL CLASSIFICATION: D21 M54 O32
abstract_zh: 碳排放交易机制提高了受监管企业的生产成本，这无疑会激励企业参与技术研发。然而，碳价格是否会导致企业创新资源的错配尚不明确。当研发劳动力和资本出现错配时，研发支出的增加并不必然转化为创新收益。因此，本文聚焦中国碳排放交易机制，系统考察碳价格是否影响企业创新资源配置，并进一步评估纠正此类错配后的社会福利效应。分析表明，碳价格对研发资本和劳动力错配均呈现倒U型影响；超过特定阈值后，碳价格有助于减少研发资源错配。进一步分析显示，纠正这些错配能显著提升创新产出的数量与质量。这些发现拓展了碳价格机制的研究，凸显了创新资源配置效率在气候治理中的重要性，并为设计兼顾减排目标与创新效率的碳价格政策提供了实证依据。关键词：碳价格 创新资源错配 研发资本错配 研发劳动力错配 福利分析 JEL分类：D21 M54 O32
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为中国碳排放交易机制，数据、制度背景均基于中国
title: Carbon price and the misallocation of enterprise innovation resources
title_zh: 碳价格与企业创新资源的错配

abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。
authors: Frank Verboven; Youngjin Hong; In Kyung Kim
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象、数据、政策背景均为韩国，不涉及中国
title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
title_zh: DP21757 补贴哪种绿色技术？来自韩国电动汽车的证据

abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。
title: Immigration's Effect on US Wages and Employment Redux
title_zh: DP21756 移民对美国工资与就业的再审视

abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据

abstract: This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。

title: From Tap Water Access to Income‐Generating Work Time: Evidence From Rural China
title_zh: 从自来水接入到创收工作时间：来自中国农村的证据

abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization. KEYWORDS: Green fiscal policy carbon emission mitigation urban decarbonization sustainable development JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 Q58 R11
abstract_zh: 在气候变化日益紧迫与全球追求净零排放的背景下，绿色财政政策已成为推动可持续发展的重要工具。本研究考察了绿色财政政策对城市碳减排的影响，重点关注其作用机制与异质性效应。基于2002至2022年中国274个地级市的面板数据，以节能减排财政政策综合示范作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法进行分析。结果表明，绿色财政政策显著促进了城市碳减排，且在污染程度较高的城市中效果更为显著。机制分析显示，绿色创新与总能源消耗降低是正向传导渠道，而政府环境关注度则发挥负向中介作用。此外，创业活动强化了绿色财政政策的效应，而财政压力则削弱了该效应。这些发现支持分阶段推进绿色财政政策扩张、在高污染城市加强执行力度、在低污染地区强化激励措施、提升透明度与监管水平、以创新驱动效率提升与清洁能源替代，以及通过灵活融资维持脱碳进程。关键词：绿色财政政策；碳减排；城市脱碳；可持续发展 JEL分类：Q54 Q58 R11

title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响

abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。
title: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
title_zh: DP21755 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示

abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。
authors: Thilo Nils Hendrik Albers, Alexander Nützenadel, Tobias Scheib
title: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
title_zh: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化

abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.
abstract_zh: 全球化深刻改变了经济学研究，使其更具可比性、竞争性，并彻底走向定量化。本专栏认为，人工智能可能像当年全球化颠覆旧秩序一样，彻底动摇这一新格局，并探讨了其中涉及的技术与地缘政治机制。一个高度可信的预测是：三十年后醒来的人，很可能像三十年前入睡、今天才醒来的人一样，几乎认不出经济学这门学科。
title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来

abstract: Equal pay for equal work has been a core EU principle since 1957, yet women across Europe continue to earn less than men, even in very similar jobs. As EU countries begin implementing the new Pay Transparency Directive, greater wage transparency is expected to narrow these gaps. This column explores the potential effects on the 27 EU countries. Equal pay could substantially narrow gender disparities, but the gains are greater where unequal pay among comparable workers is a key driver of the gender pay gap.
abstract_zh: 同工同酬自1957年起便是欧盟的核心原则，然而即便在高度相似的岗位上，欧洲女性收入仍普遍低于男性。随着欧盟各国开始实施新的《薪酬透明指令》，更高的薪酬透明度有望缩小这些差距。本文探讨了该指令对27个欧盟国家的潜在影响。同工同酬可显著缩小性别差异，但在可比劳动者薪酬不平等是性别薪酬差距主要驱动因素的国家，其收益更为显著。
authors: Silvia De Poli, Sofia Maier, Viginta Ivaškaitė-Tamošiūnė
title: The new EU Pay Transparency Directive may reshape wages and the gender pay gap
title_zh: 新欧盟薪酬透明度指令可能重塑工资与性别薪酬差距

abstract: Local communities are widely blamed for the increasing deforestation in Malawi, primarily due to agricultural expansion and the increased use of biomass energy. Yet, there is limited evidence to understand systemic trade-offs that communities face in their land-use decisions. This study examines the drivers of deforestation in Southern Malawi, focusing on community perceptions and the resource Nexus outcomes related to deforestation. We conducted 25 focus group discussions, 22 key informant interviews, and 271 household interviews across Chikwawa, Blantyre, Mwanza, Mulanje, and Thyolo districts. We also conducted seven expert interviews, facilitated five participatory workshops, and employed ethnographic techniques to gather the lived experiences of community members. The study reveals that (1) socio-economic needs for food, energy and income create a vicious cycle of cropland expansion at the direct expense of forest conservation. (2) Community perceptions identify biomass energy production (index=0.0788) as the main driver of deforestation, followed by cropland expansion (0.0769) and energy poverty (0.0746). (3) The dominance of negative ecological outcomes, followed by economic and political outcomes. The socio-cultural dimension reports the least negative outcomes. Nonetheless, positive outcomes are highest in the socio-cultural dimension, followed by the economic and political dimensions. The least positive outcomes are reported in the ecological dimension. The study empirically shows how community perceptions reshape the Resource Nexus and offers geographically specific policy recommendations. It treats deforestation as both socioeconomic and ecological problem, calling for integrated policies that address livelihood needs and structural drivers in Southern Malawi and similar areas in Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 当地社区被广泛指责为马拉维森林砍伐加剧的主要原因，这主要源于农业扩张和生物质能源使用的增加。然而，关于社区在土地利用决策中面临的系统性权衡，现有证据十分有限。本研究聚焦马拉维南部森林砍伐的驱动因素，重点关注社区认知及与森林砍伐相关的资源纽带结果。我们在奇夸瓦、布兰太尔、姆万扎、穆兰杰和蒂约洛地区开展了25场焦点小组讨论、22次关键知情人访谈和271户家庭访谈。此外，我们还进行了7次专家访谈、组织了5场参与式研讨会，并运用民族志方法收集社区成员的生活经验。研究表明：（1）对食物、能源和收入的社会经济需求形成了耕地扩张的恶性循环，直接牺牲了森林保护；（2）社区认知将生物质能源生产（指数=0.0788）视为森林砍伐的首要驱动因素，其次是耕地扩张（0.0769）和能源贫困（0.0746）；（3）负面生态结果占主导地位，其次是经济和政治结果，而社会文化维度报告的负面结果最少。尽管如此，正面结果在社会文化维度最高，其次是经济和政治维度，生态维度报告的正面结果最少。本研究实证展示了社区认知如何重塑资源纽带，并提出了具有地理针对性的政策建议。它将森林砍伐视为社会经济与生态的双重问题，呼吁采取综合政策应对马拉维南部及撒哈拉以南非洲类似地区的生计需求和结构性驱动因素。
title: Food, fuel, or forest? Interrogating the resource nexus dilemma behind deforestation through community-lived experiences in southern Malawi
title_zh: 食物、燃料还是森林？通过马拉维南部社区生活经验审视森林砍伐背后的资源关联困境

abstract: Departmentalized instruction, in which teachers specialize in one or more core subjects and instruct multiple groups of students in a day, has become increasingly prominent in elementary schools. Departmentalization involves a potential trade-off: specialized assignments exploit teacher comparative advantage across subjects but introduce coordination costs across teams of teachers instructing common students. Using 8 years of data from Massachusetts and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of departmentalization on student achievement. Overall, we find that departmentalization has positive effects in English language arts (ELA) and science and either null or positive effects in math. Consistent with prior findings on teacher specialization, teachers are less effective when specializing in math and no more effective in ELA than when teaching self-contained classrooms. Rather, the improvements are driven by departmentalized schools assigning teachers to their stronger subjects.
abstract_zh: 分科教学（即教师专攻一门或多门核心学科，并在一天内教授多个学生群体）在小学中日益普遍。这种教学方式涉及一种潜在的权衡：专业化分工能够发挥教师在不同学科上的比较优势，但也会在教授同一批学生的教师团队之间产生协调成本。利用马萨诸塞州八年的数据及双重差分法，我们估算了分科教学对学生学业成绩的影响。总体而言，我们发现分科教学对英语语言艺术和科学学科具有积极影响，而对数学学科则呈现无影响或积极影响。与先前关于教师专业化的研究结论一致，教师在专攻数学时教学效率较低，而在英语语言艺术学科上的教学效果并不优于包班制教学。相反，学业成绩的提升主要源于分科学校将教师分配至其更擅长的学科。
title: Departmentalized instruction and elementary school effectiveness
title_zh: 分科教学与小学教育效能

abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and handcollected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。
title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给

abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including countercyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。
title: Demand Shocks and Endogenous Uncertainty
title_zh: 需求冲击与内生不确定性
